summary: Build practical food systems resilience and nutrition-sensitive agriculture skills through assessments, design tools, and reporting templates. Enrol now.
lede: Food systems resilience and nutrition-sensitive agriculture link agricultural production, dietary diversity and resilience planning. The course is for professionals in agriculture, food security, nutrition or resilience programming who need to assess food-system vulnerability, plan diversified production and post-harvest interventions, and monitor dietary diversity and resilience targets.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in agriculture, food security, nutrition, rural development, or resilience programming and need to connect field realities with measurable food systems outcomes.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet confidence, and familiarity with agricultural or nutrition programme data. If your organization has baseline surveys, seasonal calendars, market assessments, or programme reports, those materials will help you apply the exercises more directly, though sample datasets and templates can also support participation.
